entry.author: Whakatāne isite Visitor Information Centre
entry.summary:
Tracy Anderson from Rangitāiki Home Kills talks about their upcoming demo at the 2018 Local Wild Food Challenge. 

Paddock to Plate - Beast Breakdown
Specialists in certified Home Kill, small goods, wild game and the Paddock to Plate concept, Tracey, Art & Jess will take you through the art of a complete ‘Beast Breakdown’, then sell you some tasty
local salami. Talk to them about what they can offer and how they do what they do so very well.
Visit our website to find out more: https://www.whakatane.com/events/local-wild-food-challenge
